selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: At this stopping-place, what central belief is being explained through the traveler’s observations?
questions.answer: The passage explains Allah’s oneness and shows many signs that point to Him as the only true God.

questions.question: At this stage of the journey, what kind of truths has he noticed?
questions.answer: He has noticed truths that witness to Divine unity.

questions.question: What kind of witness comes from the greatness seen in the universe?
questions.answer: It is a witness that the One with such complete greatness must be Allah alone.

questions.question: How are Allah’s actions in creation described in relation to limits?
questions.answer: They are described as boundless, with no restriction except His will and wisdom.

questions.question: What contrast in creation makes Allah’s power especially clear?
questions.answer: The contrast is that countless things are created in great numbers while still being made swiftly, easily, and beautifully.

questions.question: What can we understand from the fact that beings are interconnected?
questions.answer: We can understand that they are parts of one planned system.

questions.question: What does the unity of the sources of order in the universe show?
questions.answer: It shows that the Maker of the universe is one.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the management centers or sources of cosmic order?
questions.answer: It says their unity clearly points to the unity of the One who made the universe.

questions.question: What do the earth’s widespread elements and species testify to?
questions.answer: They testify that the whole earth is under one Lord’s command.

questions.question: What is the main idea of the long statement in the target passage?
questions.answer: It gathers many proofs from the world to show that Allah is one and unique.

questions.question: Why does the passage not rely on just one sign?
questions.answer: Because it gathers many different signs so the proof becomes stronger and clearer.

questions.question: What does the witness of greatness and majesty point to?
questions.answer: It points to Allah’s complete and unmatched greatness.

questions.question: What can a reader infer from the creation of huge numbers of beings with speed, ease, and beauty?
questions.answer: A reader can infer that one perfect Creator brings them into being without struggle.

questions.question: How does the passage connect large quantity with fine craftsmanship?
questions.answer: It presents both together as a sign of one all-powerful and all-wise Creator.

questions.question: What does the passage say about how beings exist across the universe?
questions.answer: It says they exist in a broad, connected, and mutually related way.

questions.question: Why is assigning partners to Allah rejected by the passage?
questions.answer: Because the worldwide order is so united and consistent that shared control would not fit it.

questions.question: Why are the Divine Names and deeds mentioned after cosmic order?
questions.answer: Because their shared action throughout the universe gives another proof of the same unity.

questions.question: Why are the elements and species on earth important in this proof?
questions.answer: Because their spread and control over the earth show one command over all.

questions.question: Who is being spoken about as observing these truths in the world?
questions.answer: A traveler or voyager reflecting on the universe is being described.

questions.question: How is Allah described alongside His oneness in the passage?
questions.answer: He is described as one, unique, and necessarily existing.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the greatness and vastness seen in creation?
questions.answer: It shows that Allah’s majesty and greatness are perfect and all-encompassing.

questions.question: Why does the passage connect Allah’s will and wisdom with the actions seen in creation?
questions.answer: To show that creation is purposeful and controlled, not random.

questions.question: What does the mention of artistry and value add to the argument?
questions.answer: It shows that creation is not only numerous but also meaningful, beautiful, and carefully made.

questions.question: Why is the universal order in the universe important for understanding tawhid?
questions.answer: Because such complete order does not fit the idea of many gods sharing control.
